semantic_contract: parse the user value with kstrtouint_from_user using base 10
return -EINVAL without logging or callback on parse failure
log set_rotation_limit_level and the parsed unsigned value
load the optional callback from tpd_cdev + 0xe80 with callback KCFI type 0x6af8b499
pass struct ztp_device * and the parsed integer to the callback
return the original count on success or when no callback is installed

evidence.raw_difference: The instruction sequence is byte-identical to stock. Local .rodata relocation offsets differ because the candidate module is independently linked; normalized relocation identity and pointed-to strings match stock.

follow_up_required: Review local .rodata symbol placement only if raw link-time offsets are required; normalized relocation identity is exact.
Run controlled procfs/userspace and NX809J runtime validation after the offline driver set is complete.
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, byte-identical 49-instruction/196-byte AArch64 body, matching function and indirect callback KCFI contracts, strict Joern with zero unresolved calls, reproducible Docker build, and three-case two-cycle ASan/UBSan host contract.
